name: cherrygrove
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished complete overhead town artwork preview for a Pokemon GBA-engine game, part of a coordinated five-region set. Image 1 is STYLE reference: match its rich dimensional pixel-art materials, attractive architecture and sculpted tree crowns, but make it cleaner and more modular, never blurry or painterly. Image 2 is GEOGRAPHY reference, preserve its main landmark arrangement. Strict fixed Pokemon orthographic overhead view with south-facing facades, no perspective convergence, no isometric angle. No text, titles, UI, annotations, or NPCs baked into scenery. Consistent object scale: one door width is one conceptual 16px tile, houses roughly 5-6 tiles wide, trees roughly 2 tiles wide and 3 high; paths 2-3 tiles wide. Render at a crisp enlarged pixel-art scale. Rich quality from deliberate clusters and 4-5 stepped shades per material, not millions of colors or noise. Shared reusable grass patch, one repeated tree crown per region with at most two variations, repeated roof courses, wall/window modules, consistent northwestern light and short contained shadows. Clean separable silhouettes, no trees cutting into roofs, no flowers on trees or pavements, no ground-colored rectangles obscuring other objects. Shore/terrain edges use reusable straight, convex and concave pieces. No gradients, haze, atmospheric lighting or long cast shadows across paths. Fully composed beautiful game map artwork, NOT a tileset sheet; no technical grid. Preserve regional identity instead of recoloring the same town.
CHERRYGROVE, JOHTO. Wide landscape composition. Follow image2: broad western blue sea, northwest rock escarpment cleanly meeting shore, curved pale beach, wooden dock from town west with lower branch landing on little island, commercial vessel on west dock side and two small fishing boats. Blue-roof Mart and orange/red Center across upper town, small banked pond and bench northeast, five warm cream timber houses with red Johto roofs through center and southeast. Connected tan paths north and east, coherent southern forest boundary. Preserve harbor and southeast housing expansion. Upgrade every asset to image1's finish, using Johto architectural identity. No extra buildings, coastline redesign or new islands.
